name: Lightning Blackjack
how: Place your ante bet before the round starts.
Lightning multipliers are drawn and applied to random card values.
Play your hand as normal blackjack; multiplier wins pay on top of standard payouts.
why: Same rules as standard blackjack with a multiplier layer on top — no added house edge on the base game.

name: Lightning Roulette
how: Bet on numbers, colors or outside bets as in standard European roulette.
Up to five Lucky Numbers are struck with multipliers each round.
Straight-up wins on a Lucky Number pay the multiplied amount instead of the standard 35:1.
why: European single-zero wheel; the multiplier round only affects straight-up numbers.
